faqs.question: What does a UPS do?
faqs.answer: A UPS keeps your equipment running on its battery when the mains power goes off. It gives you time to save your work and shut down properly, and it also helps protect your equipment from power surges.

faqs.question: How long will it keep my PC running?
faqs.answer: That depends on how much equipment you plug in. A single desktop PC will run longer than a PC with a monitor, router and other devices all connected. Tell us what you want to power on WhatsApp and we'll advise.

faqs.question: Can I plug a printer or heater into it?
faqs.answer: No. Do not plug laser printers, heaters, kettles or other high-power appliances into a UPS. Use it for computers, routers and similar electronics.
